procedural_matters: Hearing No. 9 and 10 were heard together with Hearing No. 8 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Giovanni Colucci, Race Committee attended the hearing as an observer.
The Course Representative, Javier Blanco Gomez provided video evidence.
Stefano Carattino (member of the race committee from the pin end) gave evidence as a witness for the Race Committee .
facts: In the race 2 the U Flag was used as the preparatory signal.
At the moment of the starting signal, ITA 219218 and ITA 221824 sailed at a distance of two boat length between them on port close to the pin end.
On the pin end vessel a member of the race committee sights the starting line via a staff with orange flag.
Additionally the member was recording the start via a mobile Phone from next to the staff with orange flag.
Race committee identified ITA 219218 and ITA 221824 in the triangle formed by both ends of the starting line and mark no. 1 during the last minute before the start.
Race committee scored ITA 219218 and ITA 221824 UFD in Race 2.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
